$comment: Shipped defaults. Override any of these in ~/.config/wordtap/config.json (only the keys you change). sources: which dictionaries to show, top to bottom; ids match providers/<id>.json. ocrLanguages: Tesseract languages that read the word under the pointer (at most four; "auto" = every installed pack). For accented Latin letters run scripts/ocr-accents enable instead; extra packs are for other scripts, e.g. ["eng", "rus"]. tap: the touchpad gesture that looks up the word under the pointer.
